title: Analysis code for: Shaking regimes influence the growth of human gut bacteria
description: R scripts that reproduce every analysis and figure in the paper 'Shaking regimes influence the growth of human gut bacteria' from the deposited data: endpoint-OD contrasts under static, pulsed and continuous shaking, between-run variance, within-plate reproducibility, flow-cytometry confirmation, OD-to-cell-count calibration, and blinded morphology scoring.
